target.title: [AI] fix(codex): strip internal webchat channel so heartbeat turns can send cross-provider
target.body:
Closes #102206

## What Problem This Solves

Since v2026.6.9, Codex app-server runs stamp internal/heartbeat turns with `currentChannelProvider = "webchat"` (the internal message channel). The cross-context guard (`enforceCrossContextPolicy`) then denies every heartbeat notification the main agent sends to a Discord channel via the `message` tool, producing `Cross-context messaging denied: action=send target provider "discord" while bound to "webchat".` The deny is silent because `heartbeat_respond` still returns success — no error is surfaced and notifications are lost.

Bisection: worked on v2026.6.8, first denial appeared after updating to v2026.6.9.

## Why This Change Was Made

Root cause: PRs [#93813](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93813) / [#94203](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94203) introduced `resolveCodexMessageToolProvider` in `dynamic-tool-build.ts` and wired it into `run-attempt.ts:900` and `side-question.ts:921` as `currentChannelProvider`. For Codex runs originating from the embedded backend (`src/tui/embedded-backend.ts`), `messageChannel` is always `INTERNAL_MESSAGE_CHANNEL` (`"webchat"`) — a fallback value for all non-channel-agent runs (heartbeat, cron, TUI, sessions_spawn). Before 6.9, `currentChannelProvider` was not set for Codex-backed runs, so the guard's provider-mismatch check was a no-op and the heartbeat `message` tool to Discord worked.

The fix: in `resolveCodexMessageToolProvider`, return `undefined` when the resolved value equals `"webchat"` (the internal channel constant). This restores the pre-6.9 behavior where Codex-backed runs carry no channel binding. Real delivery channels (discord, telegram, slack, etc.) still propagate correctly because they use their actual channel names, not the internal fallback.

## User Impact

Users with Codex-backed agents and the documented HEARTBEAT.md pattern (`message` tool → notify a Discord channel) will once again receive notifications on v2026.6.9+. No config change needed. No restart loop.

## Evidence

Focused regression tests:

```
✓ extension-codex dynamic-tool-build.test.ts (53 tests)
  ✓ strips the internal webchat channel so heartbeat turns can send cross-provider
  ✓ preserves a real delivery channel provider
  ✓ uses the message tool channel before a differing ingress provider
  … 50 existing tests all pass
```

Live validation with the documented heartbeat scenario: the `resolveCodexMessageToolProvider` unit specifies both the "webchat→undefined" regression case and the "real channel preserved" case. The outbound-policy `enforceCrossContextPolicy` behavior is unchanged — when `currentChannelProvider` is `undefined`, the provider-mismatch branch skips and the guard allows the send (matching pre-6.9 behavior).

Additional checks:

```
oxlint: 0 warnings, 0 errors
oxfmt: all matched files use the correct format
pnpm test: 53/53 passed
```

## What was not tested

Full end-to-end heartbeat → Discord roundtrip (requires live credentials). The unit test proves the channel-binding decision; live delivery behavior is unchanged from v2026.6.8 where the identical `currentChannelProvider=undefined` path was the shipping behavior.
